Adam,

With Groq's $20B Nvidia technology licensing deal and the company scaling to 3M+ developers on GroqCloud, your custom LPU architecture is now one of the most commercially significant inference patents in AI.

As inference becomes the primary compute bottleneck post-training, the IP landscape around streaming inference, low-latency silicon, and distributed inference deployment is becoming increasingly crowded. If you're evaluating your IP posture as Groq scales its inference cloud, we published an AI Patent Strategy Scorecard that walks through 15 critical gaps in inference-hardware IP portfolios. Happy to review it with you as you shape your IP strategy alongside the inference scaling push.
